about: When Genie offers 'Let Linker contact me' (#243, docs/specs/13-genie.md goal 6, A5), EN and DE, against the real service: the phrase table, Jev (typesafe/jev-1.13 on OpenRouter) and deepseek-flash on the official API. `offer` is the contact block's reason the turn must carry, null for none. `thread` cases post their customer messages one turn after another in one conversation; `offers` lists the reason expected on each of those turns.
